title: Colombia pre-payroll
description: Prepare, review and approve traceable payroll evidence. This workspace is not certified electronic payroll and does not replace legal or accounting review.
forbidden: Only administrators can access private pre-payroll evidence.

validation.window: Use a valid end date after the start date.
validation.periodSpan: A pre-payroll period cannot exceed 31 calendar days.
validation.payDate: The pay date cannot precede the period start.
validation.replacementDate: The replacement must start inside the selected profile period.
validation.accountLast4: Enter exactly the last four account digits.
validation.reason: Record at least 10 characters of private review evidence.

profiles.title: Employee payroll profiles
profiles.description: Store only payroll identity, contribution and payment evidence required for calculation. Every correction creates a new effective record.
profiles.empty: No payroll profiles match these filters.
profiles.loadError: Payroll profiles could not be loaded.
profiles.saveError: The payroll profile change could not be saved.
profiles.historyTruncated: Only the latest 100 history events are shown.

notices.create: Use the employee's reviewed payroll and contribution evidence. The profile does not create an employment contract.
notices.replace: The selected profile will end immediately before this replacement starts. Historical evidence will not be rewritten.
notices.end: Choose the exclusive end date. Existing calculated revisions remain frozen.
notices.void: Void only incorrect evidence. This cannot reactivate or rewrite a calculated revision.

periods.title: Pre-payroll periods
periods.description: Periods are half-open date windows and cannot overlap or cross a reviewed policy transition.
periods.empty: No pre-payroll periods match this filter.
periods.loadError: Pre-payroll periods could not be loaded.
periods.saveError: The pre-payroll period could not be created.
periods.closeError: The period could not be closed.
periods.policyNotice: Only Colombia and COP are currently reviewed. A period is rejected if one policy version does not cover every day.
periods.closeNotice: Closing requires an approved regular run and no unfinished adjustment. The period cannot be reopened.

runs.title: Pre-payroll runs
runs.empty: This period has no pre-payroll runs.
runs.loadError: The private pre-payroll run could not be loaded.
runs.saveError: The pre-payroll decision could not be saved.
runs.prePayrollNotice: Approved revisions are immutable internal evidence. Provider submission, PILA, DIAN electronic payroll and legal validation remain external.
runs.noRevision: Calculate the first revision before review.
runs.revisionsTruncated: Only the latest 100 revisions are shown.
runs.eventsTruncated: Only the latest 100 lifecycle events are shown.

blockerLabels.policy_unavailable: No reviewed policy covers the calculation date
blockerLabels.policy_acknowledgement_required: The effective policy has not been acknowledged
blockerLabels.unsupported_currency: The currency is not supported by this policy
blockerLabels.attendance_evidence_incomplete: Attendance contains an open, overlapping or incomplete record
blockerLabels.attendance_evidence_overlaps: Corrected attendance intervals overlap and would count time twice
blockerLabels.attendance_evidence_limit_exceeded: Attendance evidence exceeds the bounded review limit
blockerLabels.attendance_seconds_mismatch: Reviewed hours do not match authoritative attendance
blockerLabels.adjustment_requires_zero_automatic_base: An adjustment must keep the automatic base at zero
blockerLabels.adjustment_manual_concept_required: An adjustment needs a nonzero reviewed manual concept
blockerLabels.run_contains_blocked_employee: Another employee in this run is blocked
blockerLabels.integral_salary_minimum_not_met: Integral salary is below the reviewed legal minimum
blockerLabels.integral_salary_ibc_mismatch: Integral salary contribution base does not match the reviewed rule
blockerLabels.contribution_base_required: A reviewed contribution base is required
blockerLabels.contribution_base_above_cap: Contribution base exceeds the reviewed cap
blockerLabels.transport_assistance_ineligible: Transport assistance was marked for an ineligible profile
blockerLabels.money_range_exceeded: A monetary result exceeds the supported safe range

runs.reviewNotice: This marks revision {{revision}} as reviewed only if every employee result is complete.
runs.approveNotice: This freezes revision {{revision}} as the approved internal pre-payroll result.
runs.createNotice: Create a run for {{from}} through {{until}}. A period can have only one regular run.
runs.originalsTruncated: Only the latest 100 approved source runs are available here. Narrow the operation before continuing.

recalculate.title: Calculate immutable revision
recalculate.notice: Every employee with effective payroll evidence for the full period is included. Review each value; unreviewed or unsupported inputs remain blocked and cannot be approved.
recalculate.adjustmentNotice: Adjustments reuse the approved source authority. Automatic base must remain zero and every employee needs a nonzero manual concept.
recalculate.employeeLimit: More than 100 profile or contract rows match. Refine the employee data before calculating; hidden rows are not submitted.
recalculate.preparationBlocked: Resolve every missing, overlapping or incompatible effective payroll record before calculating. No employee will be omitted silently.
recalculate.preparationStale: This run changed while its employee evidence was loading. Close and reopen the calculation.
recalculate.employeeConfigurationBlocked: This employee needs one compatible profile and employment contract covering the whole period.
recalculate.attendanceBlocked: Resolve open, overlapping or otherwise incomplete attendance evidence before calculating.
recalculate.derivedWorkedHours: Attendance-derived hours: {{hours}}. This authoritative value is locked and submitted in exact seconds.
recalculate.historicalInactive: The employee or site is currently inactive; effective historical evidence is still included.

configurationBlockers.missing_profile: Create a payroll profile covering the whole period.
configurationBlockers.missing_contract: Create an employment contract covering the whole period.
configurationBlockers.ambiguous_profile: End or void overlapping payroll profiles.
configurationBlockers.ambiguous_contract: End or void overlapping employment contracts.
configurationBlockers.profile_site_mismatch: Use the same site in the payroll profile and employment contract.
configurationBlockers.profile_contract_window_mismatch: Align the payroll profile and employment contract so they share covered dates in this period.
configurationBlockers.unsupported_country: Use a reviewed Colombia payroll profile.
configurationBlockers.unsupported_currency: Use COP compensation for this Colombia period.
configurationBlockers.time_zone_mismatch: Align the employment contract time zone with the business time zone.
configurationBlockers.missing_employee: Restore or correct the referenced employee record.
configurationBlockers.missing_site: Restore or correct the referenced site record.
configurationBlockers.employee_limit_exceeded: This run exceeds the supported limit of 500 employees. Split support requires a reviewed design before proceeding.

recalculate.noEligible: No employee has matching profile and contract evidence for the full period.
recalculate.validation: Select at least one employee and complete every displayed value with a private review reason. Acknowledging the policy is required.
recalculate.policyAcknowledged: I reviewed the effective policy, its sources and documented limitations for this whole period.
